prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally overoptimistic for non-winning tests, but underpredicted gains for the winning tests.
sign_in hint and home wait_info were helpful changes, as both won their tests.
choose_path copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence remains thin for all other specific change types as each has only been tested once.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +1.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: -0.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: -0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, layout: -2.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: -6.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, notification: +0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -0.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +3.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +3.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -3.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.1%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Changes:
0: [home, redesign] Desktop Hatching Progress Stage Layout: Redesign the waiting screen into a split stage layout displaying a real-time pet hatching progress visualization and system readiness checklist. (why: Home step median time is 201s (mean 2336s) and support received bug reports about desktop pets not displaying; a split stage clear visualization keeps users informed.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Presence Verification Screen: Add a new desktop presence check screen right after waiting to verify pet display and tray icon visibility before the home intro screen. (why: 3 support emails reported the pet not showing on desktop or app failing to open upon setup completion; adding a dedicated verification screen catches display issues early.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Pet Adoption Naming Sub-Flow: Transform the adoption certificate step into an interactive sub-flow with live pet naming input and certificate customization. (why: Adoption stage has the lowest step conversion rate (60.9%); an interactive custom naming flow deepens emotional attachment and completion rates.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Recovery Pet Sync Safety Hint: Add an explicit hint to the sign-in screen informing users that signing into their account automatically restores all previously owned pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again; sign_in hints were proven successful in prior tests.)
4: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Time and Progress Wait Status: Enable detailed progress status, step counter, and time estimate countdown on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has a 201s median / 2336s mean time; previous wait_info additions won their tests by reducing uncertainty.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Focused Spotlight Path Layout: Change the path selection screen layout to spotlight, highlighting one path card prominently at a time. (why: choose_path mean time of 514s suggests decision paralysis; spotlight layout reduces visual noise and speeds up path selection.)
6: [finish, notification] Desktop Companion Quick Controls Banner: Add a highlighted notification banner on the final intro screen showing desktop tray and click interaction shortcuts. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
7: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Recovery Copy Clarification: Update sign-in screen headline and body copy to explicitly instruct returning users to sign in to retrieve their pets. (why: Addresses 8 support tickets where users created duplicate accounts or thought pets were deleted upon re-login.)

scores.note: Redesigning home screen showed 0.0% lift previously; high implementation cost for zero expected gain.
Adding a new screen increases onboarding friction; finish step changes previously resulted in negative lift.
Targeting lowest conversion step (60.9%) has high potential, but full sub-flow requires high build effort.
Sign-in hints previously won with +3.1% lift, strongly backed by 8 support tickets and low implementation cost.
Home wait_info directly won prior tests (+3.9%) by addressing long wait times (201s median) at low cost.
Choose_path redesigns and copy changes consistently failed to show positive lift in previous tests.
Low cost notification banner addresses post-onboarding support issues with mild expected positive lift.
Directly targets 8 support tickets with config copy change, though copy changes historically show modest impact.
